name: serviceos
description: ServiceOS — on-demand at-home professional services for LifeOS

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lifeos/shared && npm run build -w @serviceos/shared && npm run build -w @serviceos/api && npm run build -w @serviceos/provider
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build -w @lifeos/shared && npm run build -w @serviceos/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push:dev
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @lifeos/shared && npm run build -w @serviceos/shared && npm run typecheck -w @serviceos/api && npm run typecheck -w @serviceos/provider
